full_prompt_en: A square close photograph shows a partly finished painted face on a white surface, constructed from thick, angular deposits of blue, yellow, violet, ocher, and cream paint. Both eyes occupy the upper middle; their blue irises stay sharply recognizable amid broad broken strokes around the brows and lids. A yellow-orange ridge runs down the bridge of the nose, while the cheeks split into cool blue-violet shadow and warm ocher planes. The lips near the lower center are modeled with rusty red, mauve, and blue marks rather than a smooth outline. On the right side, darker cobalt and navy paint forms a heavy vertical mass that dissolves into separate palette-knife fragments at the lower edge. The left side of the face is much less complete, with pale ground still visible between thin sketch lines and isolated colored strokes. From the lower left, a real hand holds a narrow brush whose tip touches the warm area beside the nose, revealing the scale and unfinished process. The background remains mostly blank white, with small accidental dabs and scratches scattered around the portrait. Thick paint ridges throw tiny physical shadows, and dragged blades leave squared ends and exposed undercolors. The camera is close and nearly frontal to the painted surface, allowing both the emerging facial expression and the coarse material to be read. Soft light from the upper left picks out the raised paint and the brush ferrule, while dark blue strokes create the stronger pictorial shading on the face. No writing is legible. The overall composition concentrates rough, bright color around the eyes and nose, balancing a nearly finished focal center against open working space.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形近摄照片呈现一张在白色载体上尚未完成的绘画面孔，由厚重且带棱角的蓝、黄、紫、赭和奶油色颜料堆成。双眼位于上方中央，蓝色虹膜在眉和眼睑周围宽阔破碎的笔划中仍清晰可辨。一条黄橙色棱脊沿鼻梁下行，脸颊则分为冷蓝紫暗面和暖赭平面。靠近下方中央的嘴唇以铁锈红、浅紫与蓝色痕迹塑成，而非平滑轮廓。右侧较暗的钴蓝和海军蓝颜料形成厚重竖向体块，到下边缘碎成各自分开的调色刀痕。脸左边完成度低得多，浅底在细草图线与孤立色笔之间仍可见。从左下，一只真实的手握细笔，笔尖触及鼻旁暖色区域，显露尺度与未完成过程。背景大部分保持空白，只在人物像四周散落少量偶然色点和划痕。厚颜料棱脊投下微小实体影，拖动的刀片留下方形末端与露出的底色。相机贴近且几乎正对画面，既让正在显现的面部神情，也让粗糙材料可被看清。柔光从左上方照来，挑亮凸起颜料与笔杆金属箍；深蓝笔划则在脸上制造更强的画面性阴影。没有可读文字。整体构图把粗粝亮色集中于眼鼻周围，以几乎完成的中央焦点平衡开放的工作空间。
style_prompt_en: The image has a thick impasto painting surface, with palette-knife slabs, dragged edges, and raised ridges fully visible. Broad angular color facets meet abruptly, while a few finer linear strokes articulate small focal transitions. Cobalt, indigo, violet, bright yellow, rusty orange, cream, and exposed pale ground create a lively warm-cool mosaic. Physical light catches the thickest deposits and leaves tiny crevice shadows; pictorial depth comes from dark cool patches set beside warm luminous ones. The arrangement concentrates dense worked texture in one region and lets marks fragment into open ground around it. Irregular squared ends and scraped underlayers keep the surface convincingly handmade rather than smoothly blended. The overall effect is energetic, tactile, and provisional, with color blocks and material height carrying the form.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有厚涂绘画表面，调色刀铺成的色片、拖动边缘与隆起棱脊完全可见。宽阔带角度的色彩切面骤然相接，少量较细线状笔划界定小范围焦点过渡。钴蓝、靛蓝、紫、亮黄、铁锈橘、奶油色和露出的浅底构成活泼的冷暖拼块。真实光照在最厚颜料上，凹缝留下微小实体影；画面纵深则来自暖色发亮块旁的深冷色。布局将经营过的密实纹理集中于一处，让笔迹向周围开放底面碎散。不规则方形末端和刮出的下层使表面可信地呈现手作感，而非平滑混色。整体效果有能量、可触且带未完成感，由色块与材料厚度承载形体。
theme_en: A face built from thick knife-laid blue, yellow, and violet paint beside an artist's brush
theme_zh: 画笔旁由蓝、黄、紫色厚重刀涂颜料构成的面孔
name: Palette knife drawing
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
